sources: https://flamingoeverglades.com/camping/ (the NPS concessioner's page, read in a browser)

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/ever/structured_data_ever.json (Long Pine Key: electricHookups 0; fee titles 'tent and non-electric RV'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Hot showers, free. Generators 8 a.m.-8 p.m. only. Cell service from AT&T and Verizon (NPS calls reception unreliable). A small convenience selection at the campground kiosk.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/ever/structured_data_ever.json (amenities: Dump Station, Potable Water, 'Flush Toilets - year round', 'Showers - Free', 'Showers - Hot'; 'Generators may be operated from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. only') + https://flamingoeverglades.com/camping/ ('Amenities include bath houses, a dump station and a potable water filling station', 'Long Pine Key has both AT&T and Verizon cell phone services'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://flamingoeverglades.com/camping/ ('2026-2027 Season: November 1, 2026 – April 30, 2027') + https://www.nps.gov/ever/structured_data_ever.json (operating-hours exception 'Long Pine Key Campground closed season', May 1 - October 31), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked through the park concessioner (Flamingo Adventures / Everglades Guest Services), online or at 855-708-2207, not recreation.gov. NPS: 'Reservations are available for RV's and tents along with first come first serve sites.' Register by 10 a.m., check-out 12 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/ever/structured_data_ever.json (reservationDescription: 'Reservations can be made with Everglades Guest Services by calling 1-855-708-2207'; description: 'Reservations are available for RV’s and tents along with first come first serve sites'; regulations: 'Check-out time is 12 p.m. Register by 10 a.m.') + https://flamingoeverglades.com/camping/ ('BOOK LONG PINE KEY' -> https://flamingoeverglades.com/book-now), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The concessioner gives 10% off (not the usual 50%) to seniors, active and retired military and Access Pass holders.

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/ever/structured_data_ever.json (fee description: 'A 10% discount is offered to seniors, active and retired military, and Access Pass holders') + https://flamingoeverglades.com/camping/ ('We are pleased to offer a 10% discount at Long Pine Key and Flamingo campgrounds for seniors, active & retired military as well as Access Pass holders'), read 2026-10-21

note: Everglades NP drive-in campground ~7 mi inside the main (Homestead) entrance off the park road. Run by the Flamingo Adventures / Everglades Guest Services concession (NOT recreation.gov).
summary: NPS campground data + the concessioner's page: 108 sites, RVs to 35 ft, no electric, flush toilets, free hot showers, dump and potable water, reservable with the concessioner plus first-come sites, $33 Mon-Thu / $38.50 Fri-Sun (fees left, human-checked). Changed season (year_round false) to Nov 1 - Apr 30; discounts are 10% for seniors/military/Access Pass. Water/sewer hookup values left (derived; NPS silent). Note trimmed of what the fields carry and the 'Nov-May' season the pages contradict.
flags: Inherited federal booking row looks wrong here: window_opens_days 180 is the recreation.gov standard, but Long Pine Key books through the NPS concessioner (flamingoeverglades.com / 855-708-2207), whose pages state no window.
